immutability_contract: No package additions or edits after this manifest. Any causal build or combined overlay is a separate revision. Runtime bytecode is excluded and disabled.

compatibility_evidence.selected_version_basis: FLA 0.4.2 recommends Triton >=3.2.0 and Python >=3.11, matching unchanged base. Latest 0.5.2 CUDA extra requires Torch >=2.7 and Triton >=3.3 and was not selected.
compatibility_evidence.cpu_import_limitation: FLA autotune imports query Triton active driver; GPU-free namespace cannot establish a driver. GPU admission is independent and is not asserted by this manifest.
